text: International Chinese Education is an interdisciplinary field that focuses on teaching and researching Chinese as a second language/foreign language, while promoting the international dissemination of Chinese culture. It is based on linguistics and education, integrating knowledge from various fields such as cultural studies, psychology, and cross-cultural communication. It not only addresses practical issues like "how to teach foreigners Chinese", but also explores the transmission rules of Chinese and Chinese culture in the international context. From classroom teaching in Confucius Institutes to the compilation of international Chinese textbooks, from training of foreign Chinese language teachers to the design of cross-cultural communication strategies, all these fall within the scope of research and practice of this discipline.
